title: PropertiesPanel: wire Custom ease curve dialog button
description:
## Problem

The Properties Panel frame view has a 'Custom…' button next to the ease slider that does nothing (it has a `// TODO: open custom ease curve dialog when implemented` comment and an empty onClick). The EaseCurveDialog component already exists (packages/authoring-ui/src/EaseCurveDialog.tsx) and is already fully wired in the Timeline right-click context menu, including reading and writing motionEaseCurve to the keyframe via onFrameUpdate. The Properties Panel is just not hooked up.

## Work required

1. **PropertiesPanel.tsx** – Import EaseCurveDialog. Add a local boolean state flag (e.g. showEaseCurveDialog). Replace the empty onClick on the 'Custom…' button with `() => setShowEaseCurveDialog(true)`. Render EaseCurveDialog conditionally at the bottom of the component: pass `initialCurve={motionEaseCurve ?? null}`, onConfirm calls `onFrameUpdate?.(layerIndex, frameIndex, { motionEaseCurve: curve })` then closes, onClose closes without saving. The motionEaseCurve value is already passed into the component via the existing frame props.

## Acceptance

- Select a motion-tween keyframe; the Properties Panel shows the Ease slider and a 'Custom…' button.
- Clicking 'Custom…' opens the EaseCurveDialog with the current ease curve pre-populated.
- Editing the curve and clicking OK commits motionEaseCurve to the keyframe (verified by reopening the dialog and seeing the saved curve).
- The existing linear ease numeric slider and the Custom curve should remain mutually usable (setting the slider changes motionEase; the dialog changes motionEaseCurve).
- No TypeScript errors.
